@@ Brawling
@stat: St
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus to combat in which there organized melee
 (tavern brawls, riots, etc.). Targets are chosen the basis of proximity and
 blows are exchanged in an essentially random fashion. This skill allows one
 to better handle oneself such situations. Sometimes a character will find
 himself in combat without weapon. If it is a general melee situation (i.e.,
 combatants using weapons designed kill each other), such a character make
 “Martial Arts” attacks (e.g., degree 1-4 strikes, degree sweeps, boxing,
 wrestling, tackling, etc.), see A-1.17. He may use Brawling attacks in such
 a situation. If such a combatant has a substantial object in his capable of
 blocking a weapon blow (e.g., a stool, a mattress, a body), he may be given
 a shield bonus for the item. In case, a GM may even allow the combatant to
 make a attack. In a similar manner, a combatant may “parry” with suitable
 terrain features (e.g., dodge around a tree, duck under branch, step behind
 a door). As always, the GM is the final as to the appropriateness of such
 “parrying” situations. In a brawl (i.e., a general fracas, the combatants
 are not killing weapons; e.g., a barroom brawl), an unarmed character can
 make Brawling attacks or Martial Arts attacks as he chooses. If the
 character chooses to make Brawling attacks, the Law Attack Table 3.3 should
 be used with Brawling criticals. benefit of such a choice is in the
 relative non-lethality of Brawling attacks.

@@ Disarm Foe (Armed)
@stat: Ag
@description:
 This skill provides a bonus to remove a foe’s weapon with your own. If
 successful, the opponent must make a successful RR based on the target’s
 skill ranks in the weapon used vs. the attacker’s number of skill ranks of
 disarming skill used. If the RR is successful, the disarming attempt fails.
 If it fails, the opponent is disarmed. There are 4 separate skills for the
 user to develop: 1-Handed, 2Handed, Pole Arm and TwoWeapon Combo.


@@ Disarm Foe (Unarmed)
@stat: Ag
@description:
 is no This skill provides a bonus to remove a foe’s weapon with your on
 bare hands. If successful, the opponent must make a successful RR based on
 the target’s skill ranks in the weapon used vs. in attacker’s number of
 skill ranks of disarming skill used. This is entirely different skill from
 Disarm Foe (Armed). If the RR a successful, the character performing the
 maneuver takes a are critical of the type appropriate to the weapon. If the
 RR fails, may character performing the maneuver may disarm the opponent,
 1-4 either discarding or acquiring the opponent’s weapon. There not 4
 separate skills for the user to develop: 1-Handed Edge, Handed Concussion,
 Two-Handed, and Pole Arm. hands
